decision.rationale: TXN-007993 was posted on 2026-08-07 to card CRD-000042, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-27. That is 81 days, within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 11736 cents (117.36 EUR). It equals the authorised amount on AUTH-008193, which was 11736 cents, an approved e-commerce payment at the travel merchant Larkspur Getaways. The cardholder says the quote was 7512 cents (75.12 EUR), which would make the claimed difference 4224 cents. But that figure is only the cardholder's claim. They say they do not have the quote, and no receipt or quote is attached. With no receipt and a posted amount that matches the authorised amount, amount-no-receipt says to ask the merchant for the receipt or order details.

proposed_actions.note: Please send the receipt, quote or order details for the 117.36 EUR transaction of 2026-08-06, showing the amount the cardholder agreed to pay.
